items.title: Shelly Berg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: The transcript identifies Monk Rowe as the interviewer ('My name is Monk Rowe') and the interviewee (Shelly Berg) responds to him. No personal or professional relationship beyond the interview context is described.

ctx.x: Shelly was interviewed in Scottsdale, Arizona on April 15, 2000, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

We are filming for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive in Scottsdale, Arizona. My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very pleased to have Shelly Berg with me at the festival, and you seem to be a guy who wears a lot of different hats.
Yeah, my life is about hats. Yeah. Educator, doing a fair bit of composing and scoring and traveling around and playing, and so yeah, it’s a juggling act.
